facts.fact: Bamada.net, repeating Le Pays, reports Mali's electoral lists are revised each 1 October to 31 December and are drawn from the biometric civil-status database; the 2026 revision opened on 1 October.
The lists are established from the biometric civil-status database, with the national identification number (NINA) as the voter's unique identifier.
